property_summary: For any caller and any log address, a call to SetLogFile after the contract has been Initialized() must revert (initialization is permanent), so the boundary call's success flag is always false in the reference; the mutant deletes the revert guard, so the same post-initialization SetLogFile call succeeds and Log gets overwritten.
change_summary: Delete the guard statement `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetLogFile can still change Log even after initialization.
